name: Ben Hayes

background.summary: Ben has a broad background across design, video, data analysis, automation, teaching, ecommerce and industrial laboratory work.
workHistory: Design teacher at TasTAFE, UTAS and Foundry

tasmaniaCrashMap.description: A personal road-awareness app using Tasmanian crash data, GPS, weather, dashboard visuals and AI voice to make an older car smarter.
tasmaniaCrashMap.motivation: Ben wants to increase his own safety and defensibility on the road using ubiquitous data and technology.

sideHustleStudio.description: Automation and AI consultancy work for small businesses.

analytica.description: Civic data project that turns large council agendas into clearer public updates.

ghostPro.description: Resume and cover letter generation system using AI.

beyondObsolete.description: Podcast and prototype-based exploration of AI, media, technology and society.

thinkingStyle.description: Ben often explores how systems work underneath the surface. He prefers building practical tools that solve real problems in his own life before trying to predict what a wider market wants.

communicationPreferences.style: direct, useful, contextual and not overly polished

personalOperatingPrinciples: Build what is useful in real life.
Use data to make better decisions.
Prefer practical prototypes over abstract ideas.
Avoid building features just because they are popular.
Start with personal need, then expand only if the tool proves useful.
